第15章 太合麦田老板宋柯上门-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

刚从办公室出来，魏沐就碰见了熟人。

江疏颖上身穿着一件浅灰色薄款针织开衫，下半身直筒牛仔裤包裹着一双笔直长腿。

不像后世那样御姐气十足，现在的她身上还带着一丝稚嫩。

江疏颖两手放在背后，嘴角噙着笑意。

“魏沐，恭喜啦。”

“谢谢。”

看了看四周，没什么人。

从班主任办公室出来的时候，魏沐特意看了下时间，刚过中午十二点。

正常来讲，现在学生应该都在吃饭或者是前往食堂的路上。

但是江疏颖，却意外的出现在这里。

这妹子有事？

“你现在可是学校里的大红人，我下次见到你，是不是该问你要签名？”

“没有的事，我就写了一首歌而已，倒是你，不是准备去英国？”

慢慢把头发撩至耳后，江疏颖轻轻点点头。

还真是。

这女人和正常女人脑子不太一样。

作为上戏表演班学生，大家不是签约经纪公司，就是到处跑剧组找机会。

她倒好，毕了业直接去英国留学两年，回来的时候已经2010年。

黄花菜都凉了！！

魏沐上辈子看过不少小道消息。

有人说她这个时候惹到事情，不得不跑到国外避风头。

还有人说她出去就是为了混文凭，给自己镀金。

反正说什么的都有。

魏沐更倾向于后者。

如果真是前者，整个上戏早就传遍了。

这种大八卦瞒不下去，尤其在娱乐圈，更不可能。

“嗯，祝你在国外一切顺利，咱们有空多联系。”

“好呀。我到国外留学没什么朋友，无聊的时候可能会找你聊天，你不会介意吧？”

说到这里，江疏颖的脸颊渐渐泛起一抹酡红。

嘶.....茶味扑鼻。

这个时候的江疏颖还是比较稚嫩，远远没有到达未来的段位。

只能算个初级绿茶。

整个04级表演班，谁不知道王晓晨和他分手？

这女人现在凑上来，意思很明白。

想刷个脸，在他心里留个印象。

来日方长嘛。

这种小绿茶，他魏老板上辈子遇到不少，每次都是狠狠地拿捏。

主打一个只谈感情，享受快乐，不谈金钱。

As soon as he came out of the office, Wei Mu met an acquaintance.

Jiang Shuying wore a light gray thin knitted cardigan on her upper body, and her lower body was wrapped in straight jeans with a pair of straight long legs.

Unlike later generations, she is not full of sisterly spirit, but now she still has a hint of childishness about her.

Jiang Shuying put her hands behind her back with a smile on her lips.

"Wei Mu, congratulations."

"Thank you."

I looked around, but there was no one there.

When coming out of the head teacher's office, Wei Mu looked at the time and saw that it was just past twelve noon.

Normally, students should be eating or on their way to the cafeteria now.

But Jiang Shuying appeared here unexpectedly.

Is there something wrong with this girl?

"You are now a famous person in the school. Next time I see you, should I ask you for your autograph?"

"Nothing, I just wrote a song. But you, aren't you planning to go to England?"

Slowly tucking her hair behind her ears, Jiang Shuying nodded gently.

It's true.

This woman's brain is different from that of a normal woman.

As students in an acting class, everyone either signs with an agency or goes around to the theater crew looking for opportunities.

Fortunately for her, she went to study in the UK for two years directly after graduation, and it was already 2010 when she came back.

The day lilies are cold!!

Wei Mu had seen a lot of gossip in his previous life.

Some people said that she got into trouble at this time and had to go abroad to avoid the limelight.

Others say that she went out just to get a diploma and gild herself.

Anyway, there is anything to say.

Wei Mu prefers the latter.

If it were the former, it would have spread throughout the theater.

This kind of big gossip cannot be hidden, especially in the entertainment industry, it is even more impossible.

"Well, I wish you all the best abroad. Let's keep in touch when we have time."

"Okay. I don't have many friends when I study abroad. I might chat with you when I'm bored. Wouldn't you mind?"

Speaking of this, Jiang Shuying's cheeks gradually turned red.

Hiss...the smell of tea is tangy.

At this time, Jiang Shuying was still relatively immature and far from reaching her future rank.

It can only be considered a junior green tea.

Who in the entire 04-level acting class didn’t know that Wang Xiaochen broke up with him?

This woman is coming forward now, her meaning is very clear.

I want to brush my face and leave an impression on him.

The days are long.

Boss Wei had encountered a lot of this kind of green tea in his previous life, and he always dealt with it harshly.

The main theme is about relationships, enjoying happiness, not money.
